name: fable-advisor
description: A small control plane for delegation: your session implements by default, and delegates only when the delegation buys cross-vendor independence, quota distribution, isolation, or a stronger review. Ships three lanes — a Codex lane (GPT-5.6 Luna) for cross-vendor implementation and ChatGPT-quota work, one model-parameterized Claude-side implementer (haiku/sonnet/fable, chosen on the spawn), and a read-only Fable 5 reviewer used in proportion to blast radius. Includes the silence-gap check for defects of omission and a two-pass review that keeps the reviewer from inheriting the implementer's claims.
